review.title: Thermophilic biomethanation: six rank-level reference correspondences with assay and causal limits retained
review.independence_basis: The executing agent read the whole canonical record, retained primary Methods and Results, exact native routes, source judgments and historical batch 120 contract. Root independently accepted the complete source preparation, actual M5 candidate and all 29 stage inputs, then the actual application and gate/history configuration. The local preview also received independent peer review. This is a partial technical self-review, not a new full scientific assessment.
review.summary: Six existing overlapping descriptors now have native reference blocks and GROUNDED statuses, with two appended native events and one native sidecar. The phylum populations include narrow Methanobacteriota and non-type Bacillota_A majorities. All biological content, source names, roles, abundance wording, quotations and old history remain unchanged, including unresolved scientific concerns. Eight actual scoped native commands bind the applied bytes.
review.scope_description: Only the six taxonomy reference blocks/statuses, guarded application, appended native history, reference-population interpretation and eight scoped native checks. The assessment does not validate organism survival or activity, reactor membership of calibration strains, taxon-specific flux, abundance timing or unqualified functional roles.
review.selection: CommunityMech:000416 follows the independently completed 436 whole-record canary in this lane. Only 416 is assessed here; 494 remains unapplied. Complete saved-input checkpoints precede caller evolution and later applications.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Native checks do not establish full scientific review, measured quotation coverage, current generated products, full QC or campaign completion.

Source coverage comprises the retained primary main-text Methods 2.1-2.4, Results 3.1 and 3.2.4, conclusion and relevant figure/phase context, the complete canonical record and source preparation. No new source acquisition, raw sequencing analysis, viability experiment or independent taxon-specific flux measurement was performed.

The filtered reference populations in taxonomy order are Methanobacteriota phylum 2815/5300 at fraction 0.531, Bacillota_A phylum 226306/451729 at 0.501, Coprothermobacterota phylum 32/32, Methanobacteria class 2810/2810, Methanosarcina genus 301/301 and Methanothrix genus 94/117 at 0.803. Fractions are native rounded values; reference counts are not source read abundances, viable cells, reactor replicates or activity estimates.

Both phylum majorities are narrow. Bacillota_A is a non-type majority; the unsuffixed type-bearing clade has 185026 references. The source-bound result does not justify a general near-tie threshold relaxation or identify a reactor-stock genome. Future strict near-tie admission must authenticate this exact completed proof.

Six taxonomy entries overlap in rank and are not six isolated community members. Preserve the preferred Euryarchaeota, Firmicutes and Methanosaeta names, exact NCBI descriptors and null strain identifiers. Methanosaeta-to-Methanothrix correspondence is nomenclature at reference genus level.

DSM 863, DSM 800 and DSM 6752 in the source are qPCR calibration/control cultures, not identified members of the reactor. The experiment used a single proof-of-concept CSTR and sequential operating phases, with washout and temperature/feed changes that limit causal attribution.

Total-DNA sequencing and qPCR do not establish viability, growth or taxon-specific activity. The source phase-average 78/16/4 phylum profile is distinct from day-69 qPCR. Existing day-69 abundance wording and unqualified roles are preserved as unresolved concerns, not endorsed by this reference-only correction.

Observed methane content of 86 percent remains distinct from proposed performance above 90 percent. Preserve external H2/CO2 feed, sequential-phase confounding, washout alternatives and non-sterile scale-up uncertainty. No interspecies arrow or mechanistic claim is added.

Captured issue 1932 is CLOSED and documents a prior graph correction. Captured issue 1935 is OPEN and retains non-graph viability/activity, abundance-timing and role concerns. Both exact snapshots are additional captured inputs through the unchanged provenance wrapper. No scientific finding is closed here.

Actual staging, application and all eight native commands ran at frozen M5 revision 261941db9aa5c359dc7599f28e4648a6c9723396 with Python 3.13.2. Every actual gate followed its free plan. The two native inline events record six changed descriptors; one new sidecar binds the actual apply receipt.

The exact crosswalk bytes are 761d5537 with an unestablished release. NCBI authority is observed by file identity/stat rather than a full database digest. Native terms reports a pass without an assertion denominator and is not measured quotation validation.

The original batch 120 ledger and current biological predicates remain protected. Later strict admission may project only the authenticated historical 416 digest/event checks, while preserving the published 454 C8S5 and existing 106 C14S5 chains. The current captured caller is retained in the complete input checkpoint before any dependency import or caller change.

assessments.topic: Overlapping source ranks and calibration cultures remain distinct from reactor-stock identity
assessments.summary: The retained primary context supports source phylum/class/genus descriptors, with unchanged preferred names and absent stock identities. DSM controls are not reactor members, and total-DNA assays do not establish viability or activity. Source timing/role limitations remain explicit rather than cleared.

assessments.topic: Six filtered rank populations retain narrow-majority and non-type limits
assessments.summary: Native populations are 2815/5300, 226306/451729, 32/32, 2810/2810, 301/301 and 94/117 in taxonomy order. The first two are narrow majorities and Bacillota_A is non-type. Fractions describe reference populations, not source read abundance, viable cells, methane flux or stock-genome placement; no threshold policy is relaxed.
